title: Short sight-seeing tours in Seville with a River point of view.
text: This was great fun if you don’t have a lot of time, as we only did the one hour tour.  I would love to do a longer version of this sort of thing all the way to the Doñana Reserve.  The pilot/guide was a friendly type who spoke many lanuages and could tell us many things. I definitely recommend doing this cruise while in Seville.
author: Alicia_S

title: Beautiful sites, lovely staff, good value for money
text:
Lovely staff, our captain Josè was super helpful and very insightful! Opportunity to buy drinks on board but could also take our own. 

Amazing sights and would definitely do it again!
